_readme: Copy to config.json and edit. Only pool_fee_address (and status_push_token, if you use a dashboard) are sensitive — never commit your real config.json.
_status_push_readme: Optional: POST the live status snapshot to an external dashboard. Leave empty to disable.
_internal_worker_prefixes_readme: Optional: worker prefixes/labels belonging to your own test rigs. Their shares are excluded from the public shares_total / shares_rejected and counted separately as internal_accepted / internal_rejected. Matches the whole worker string or the label after the last dot. Leave [] to count everything.

vardiff._fixed_worker_prefixes_readme: Workers with these prefixes keep a fixed difficulty (handy for pool-internal test rigs).

mode2._readme: Non-custodial payout: the coinbase transaction itself pays the miner. 99% goes to the address embedded in the worker name, 1% (fee_pct) to pool_fee_address. Requires zebrad mining.getblocktemplate with coinbase/value-pool support.
mode2._whitelist_prefixes_readme: Worker names starting with these prefixes bypass mode 2 (used by pool-internal test rigs). Remove entries you do not need.

zebra._readme: zebrad JSON-RPC. Prefer cookie_file, or leave user/password empty when using it.
